start.text: Disengaging cruise drive. Prepare for combat!
Ah, hunting through the void again. This is going to bring back memories.
Our fleet will blot out the sky, no matter how many suns shine above us!
The show is about to begin!
Listen up! You shall not pass!

start_boss.text: Let us vie for the stars!
This is going to be an exciting adventure!

retreat.text: You got it, boss! Whatever you say.

out_of_missiles.text: Huh!? We are out of missiles??

engaged.text: Boss! If we win this one, remember you promised to take me shopping!
Our fleet will blot out the sky, no matter how many suns shine above us!

pursuing.text: After them! Our vacation is getting away!
You will not escape this sea of fire!

hull_50.text: Do not worry, boss. I can still handle this... probably.

hull_30.text: My contract is not up yet!

overload.text: Ah! Did I get that wrong? Wait... let me think.

death.text: Looks like... I will see you later.

victory.text: Honestly, I miss the office more than I enjoy destroying things.
Now we will define success for ourselves.
Boss! Remember your promise—we are going shopping all day!
